verdict.rationale: The homepage shows a Python-style client call (`client.source_connections.create(`), which implies an official SDK. On the TypeScript side there is only the @airweave/vercel-ai-sdk package, a framework-specific search tool rather than a general SDK, plus a published OpenAPI spec that could back generated clients. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official Python and TypeScript SDKs, evidence of API parity between the two languages, coverage of full collection/source/search operations in TypeScript, and independent corroboration.
